# Hafiz Bahtiar (hafizbahtiar.com)

> Hafiz Bahtiar (also written "hafizbahtiar") is a backend and Flutter developer based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with 6+ years shipping production software: APIs on Node.js, Hono and Cloudflare Workers, and mobile apps in Flutter. hafizbahtiar.com is his personal portfolio and blog.

Not to be confused with other people named "Hafiz Bakhtiar" (with a "k").

## Pages

- [Home](https://hafizbahtiar.com/): who he is, stack, experience, contact
- [Projects](https://hafizbahtiar.com/projects): production systems - marketplaces, government platforms, logistics tooling, offline-first mobile apps
- [Blog](https://hafizbahtiar.com/blog): notes on backend systems, Flutter and shipping production software
- [Quotes](https://hafizbahtiar.com/quotes): a small collection of quotes
- [Showcase](https://hafizbahtiar.com/showcase): small free apps hosted on the site
- [Waktu Solat](https://hafizbahtiar.com/waktu-solat): today's Malaysian prayer times per JAKIM zone, with a full-screen mosque display
- [Kadar Tukaran](https://hafizbahtiar.com/kadar-tukaran): official Bank Negara Malaysia exchange rates with an RM converter
- [Kiraan Detik](https://hafizbahtiar.com/kiraan-detik): days left to Ramadan, Hari Raya and other Islamic days, per JAKIM's takwim
- [Resume (PDF)](https://hafizbahtiar.com/resume.pdf)
